verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a built-in knowledge base, document upload, or RAG feature for Deepgram Voice Agent. Function calling, system prompts, and conversation-context controls are developer building blocks or adjacent features that could be used to build retrieval, but they are not a native grounding capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
